about: The Workbench icons of the StrangeAdventures drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/sais.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a scout ship leaving a ringed planet under a star) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/sais.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. StrangeAdventures-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, StrangeAdventures.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's StrangeAdventures.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-SAIS, Manual, Mods.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
